About Me

I work between two worlds.

On one side is the business: I own products, gather requirements, manage projects and lead the change until people use what was built.

On the other side is technology: I write Python and Django, and I build AI pipelines and agents. Most projects lose time and meaning in the hand-off between these two worlds. I translate in both directions, so what gets built is what the business needs.

Projects

AI systems (projects that do API calls to various models for vector embeddings and agents)

Personal content site with an AI companion

A website that shows each visitor selective content, with an AI companion that helps them find the rest.

A functional prototype in Django. Each customer gets their own page, picked from everything on the site, with a short reason for every pick. The AI companion answers questions and brings the right page, whether that’s a recipe, a guide or a product. Every click and every question updates the customer’s profile, so the page changes with use. It runs on sample data, with two sample customers: a small shop owner and a café owner.

  • Python
  • Django
  • SQLite
  • DeepSeek API
  • Markdown

AI builder and AI workflow builder

A desktop builder for AI agents and workflows, like n8n. Written entirely by hand.

A DearPyGui desktop app. A form creates an agent in seven validated sections: name, framework and model, system prompt, user input, tools, loop control. The app writes each agent out as its own Python file. Agents and utilities sit on a grid and connect into saved workflows.

Workflow Studio

A visual builder for AI workflows: wire components on a canvas, run them against real models, see the cost of every step.

A Django and React app. Users create reusable components with typed inputs and outputs, wire them on a React Flow canvas, and run the graph. Every run is saved with a trace of each step, its output and its AI cost. Built with AI coding agents from a written specification, with about 300 tests.
